label: m4c-rssa_cr

investigation.rerun: the same chunk request through the CLI (replicate 6298 fails identically); a temporary diagnostic print, not committed, read the state at the failure
investigation.cause: the Ziggurat wait unit / total was below half an ulp of t (4.44e-16 at t = 7.16), so t + wait == t and the strict check 'clock failed to advance' (CRN-R030, also in the linear scan and in 0.6.0) failed the replicate
investigation.counts_note: in the lowered species order DA, DR, MA, DAp, MR, DRp, A, R, C; the exact total is 50 DA + 0.01 DR + 50 MA + 5 MR + C + 10 MA + 0.5 MR + 0.05 R = 3353.06

decision: 0.6.0 semantics kept: in the network engine's RSSA-CR trial loop (ssa.rs, run_path, MODE 4) every trial computes next = sampling::event_time(time, wait)? before the composition draw and the acceptance test, and event_time fails the replicate (CRN-E062, 'event time cannot advance in finite f64 arithmetic') when next <= time, also for a trial that would be rejected. The rules engine's selectors make the same check at the same place (CRN-R030 at /time, the code of the linear scan for this condition). The engine is unchanged; the failure is kept as the gate's row for vilar-noise; the remaining 18 chunks were not run.
